calculators.title: Cable Sizing Calculator
calculators.summary: Run the complete single-circuit Adelphos cable sizing workflow, including declared-current entry, correction factors, voltage drop, Ze and CPC checks.

calculators.title: Pipe Sizing Calculator
calculators.summary: Calculate a complete manufacturer-neutral pipe run with repeatable sections and declared fitting losses, without selecting equipment.

fields.label: Fluid density override
fields.hint: Leave blank to use the canonical temperature-based value.

calculators.title: Duct Sizing Calculator
calculators.summary: Calculate velocity and pressure data for a complete repeatable duct run without product selection.

calculators.title: Heat Loss Calculator
calculators.summary: Run either the complete quick room register or the full CIBSE F.01 element-schedule heat-loss method.

calculators.title: Pump Power Calculator
calculators.summary: Calculate hydraulic, shaft and electrical input power without recommending a pump.

calculators.title: Hot Water Cylinder Sizing Calculator
calculators.standard: BS 8558 · peak draw-off mixing rule and first-principles reheat
calculators.summary: Size hot-water storage from a complete peak draw-off schedule or run the clearly labelled occupancy estimate.

fields.label: Peak draw-offs at use temperature
fields.hint: Add every bath, shower, basin, sink or other simultaneous peak-period draw-off.

fields.label: Allowance per person
fields.hint: Indicative BS 8558 estimate only; use Demand mode for the design figure.

calculators.title: Ventilation Calculator
calculators.summary: Calculate either a complete Approved Document F dwelling schedule or a repeatable user-declared ACH room schedule.

calculators.title: Lighting Lux Calculator
calculators.summary: Estimate luminaire quantity and achieved illuminance from declared room and luminaire inputs.

calculators.title: Condensate Drainage Fall Calculator
calculators.summary: Calculate condensate pipe capacity from either a declared condensate rate or complete on-coil and off-coil psychrometric inputs.

calculators.title: Passivhaus Heat Demand Estimate
calculators.standard: Screening estimate — not a PHPP model
calculators.summary: Screen annual heat demand intensity; this result is not a certified PHPP model.

calculators.title: Solar PV Calculator
calculators.summary: Estimate solar array capacity, annual generation, simple energy value and CO₂ saving from direct kWp or roof-area inputs.

fields.label: Specific yield override
fields.hint: Use the project or MCS postcode-zone figure when available.

calculators.title: Heat Pump Calculator
calculators.summary: Estimate design duty without recommending a manufacturer or product.

calculators.title: Room Cooling and Heating Load Calculator
calculators.standard: P20222 RDS internally dominated room-load method
calculators.summary: Calculate a complete repeatable room cooling and heating load register from stored RDS types and declared project overrides, without selecting equipment.

calculators.title: Electrical Load Assessment Calculator
calculators.summary: Calculate connected load, explicitly diversified demand and supply current without selecting equipment.

fields.label: Load categories
fields.hint: Enter the connected load and your assessed diversity for every category. No diversity value is inferred.

calculators.title: SAP Calculator
calculators.summary: Run one stateless SAP dwelling calculation from complete, explicitly entered controlled sections.

calculators.title: Scientific Calculator
calculators.summary: Evaluate one arithmetic or scientific expression through the canonical whitelist-only Adelphos engine.

fields.label: Expression
fields.hint: Use the functions and constants accepted by the canonical evaluator.

calculators.title: Heating Zone Calculator
calculators.standard: Canonical Adelphos room-level zone calculation methods
calculators.summary: Run an explicit room heat-loss, ventilation or small-power calculation without selecting plant or equipment.
